cards.title: HELLO, I AM
cards.quote: Matsun is Armenia's traditional fermented milk. It is close to yogurt, but usually thicker, tangier, and more deeply connected to the everyday table.
cards.label: AM FOOD

cards.title: HELLO, I AM
cards.quote: At its simplest, matsun is milk transformed by fermentation. No decoration, no performance. Just something cool, sour, soft, and alive.
cards.label: AM FOOD

cards.title: HELLO, I AM
cards.quote: It appears next to lavash, herbs, cucumbers, and almost anything warm or heavy. Matsun balances the table - fresh against rich, sour against salty.
cards.label: AM FOOD

cards.title: HELLO, I AM
cards.quote: Sometimes it becomes a sauce. With garlic, herbs, salt, or a little oil, matsun turns into the quiet thing that makes dolma, soups, and vegetables feel complete.
cards.label: AM FOOD

cards.title: HELLO, I AM
cards.quote: It can also become tan - a lighter drink made with matsun and water. Cold, simple, slightly sour. The kind of thing people drink without needing to explain why.
cards.label: AM FOOD
